message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Generate a valid regression/PoC input and `analysis.json` for md4c OSS-Fuzz issue OSV-2026-727: “Global-buffer-overflow READ 4 in md_start_new_block -> md_parse -> md_html”. User instructed to continue autonomously and never ask for human response.

COMPLETED:
- Confirmed issue description from `/workspace/description.txt`.
- Inspected relevant md4c source:
  - `src/md4c.c`: block parsing, container handling, line analysis, `md_start_new_block`, `md_process_doc`, `md_end_current_block`, `md_leave_child_containers`.
  - `src/md4c.h`: `MD_BLOCKTYPE` enum values.
  - `src/md4c-html.c`: `enter_block_callback`/`leave_block_callback`, possible header array indexing, renderer setup.
- Located `MD_UNREACHABLE()` uses and container switch defaults.
- Inspected `submit.sh` validation requirements:
  - PoC must not look like JSON/prompt text.
  - `analysis.json` must contain exactly `sample_id`, `fine_trace`, `vuln_logic`.
  - `fine_trace` requires ordered objects with fields `step,file,function,line,var,code,note` and optional valid `role`.
  - `vuln_logic` requires `source,root_cause,sink,propagation`, optional `issue_alignment`.
- Built/tested several instrumentation/fuzz variants in `/tmp`, but no crashing PoC found yet.
- Ran manual trace cases involving admonitions:
  - `> [!NOTE]\nfoo\n`
  - `> [!NOTE]\n> text\nfoo\n`
  - `> [!NOTE]\n> |a|\n> |-|\nfoo\n`
  - `> [!NOTE]\n> ```\n> ```\nfoo\n`
  - `> [!NOTE]\n> ---\nfoo\n`
  These showed line transitions but no crash.
- Generated ASAN assembly for `md_start_new_block`; observed compiler emits a jump table for `line->type` with cases apparently covering only indices 0–8, indicating the reported global-buffer-overflow READ 4 likely arises from an out-of-range `line->type` used to index the switch jump table.

PENDING:
- Find/minimize an input that triggers `md_start_new_block` with out-of-range `line->type` under vulnerable build, reproducing global-buffer-overflow.
- Create PoC bytes file.
- Create valid `analysis.json` explaining source/root cause/sink/propagation.
- Run `/workspace/submit.sh <poc> <analysis.json>`.

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working directory: `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul`.
- No successful reproducer yet.
- Current hypothesis: vulnerability is due to `md_start_new_block()` switching on `line->type` without handling later `MD_LINETYPE` values (e.g. table-related or setext-related internal types), causing compiler jump-table OOB read if such a type reaches block start.
- Random fuzzing with the available harness has not hit the condition within tested time windows.

CODE_STATE:
- Main source files:
  - `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/md4c.c`
    - `md_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)` around line ~5191.
    - `md_process_doc(MD_CTX* ctx)` around line ~6568.
    - `md_leave_child_containers(MD_CTX* ctx, int n_keep)` around line ~5878.
    - `md_end_current_block(MD_CTX* ctx)` around line ~5291.
    - `md_consume_link_reference_definitions(...)` near ~5254.
  - `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/md4c.h`
    - `MD_BLOCKTYPE` enum lines ~54–108.
  - `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/md4c-html.c`
    - `enter_block_callback()` lines ~391–418.
    - `leave_block_callback()` lines ~421–435.
    - `md_html()` lines ~550–568.
- Temporary instrumentation/generated files:
  - `/tmp/md4c_check.c`: inserted checks/logging in `md_start_new_block`.
  - `/tmp/md4c_tablehook.c`: calls external `bad_start_hook(int type)` when `line->type >= 9`.
  - `/tmp/md4c_asan.s`: ASAN assembly output for `md4c.c`.
  - `/tmp/fuzz_asan`, `/tmp/fuzz_check`, `/tmp/fuzz_tablehook`: compiled test binaries.
  - `/tmp/repro_trace`: preexisting/used trace binary.
  - `/tmp/fuzz_bad.c`: fuzz harness used for experiments.

TESTS:
- ASAN fuzz command with `/tmp/fuzz_asan` produced no output for ~30s and was interrupted with Ctrl+C; exit code 130.
- `/tmp/fuzz_check` with type validation ran 20s, timed out RC=124 after ~5.4M iterations; no unexpected `line->type` detected.
- `/tmp/fuzz_tablehook` ran 60s, timed out RC=124 after ~16.2M iterations; hook for `line->type >= 9` in `md_start_new_block` did not trigger.
- Manual trace cases showed table underline line type `10` in `md_process_line`, but apparently not reaching `md_start_new_block`.

CHANGES:
- No repository source edits were made permanently.
- Only temporary `/tmp` instrumented copies and binaries were created.

DEPS:
- Built with system `cc`.
- Used ASAN/UBSAN flags in experiments:
  - `-fsanitize=address,undefined`
  - `-fno-omit-frame-pointer`
- Linked `src/md4c.c`, `src/md4c-html.c`, `src/entity.c`.
- No dependency changes.

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS:
- Repository branch/status not checked.
- No commits or PRs created.
